fields.title: Stay calm
fields.instruction: Stay calm and try to keep the patient calm and still.

fields.title: Call for real help
fields.instruction: Call local emergency services immediately — this app is a prototype, not a substitute for professional care.

fields.title: Share location
fields.instruction: Share the patient's exact location with anyone coming to help.

fields.title: Move from heat source
fields.instruction: Move the person away from the source of heat.

fields.title: Cool the area
fields.instruction: Cool the burnt area under cool (not ice-cold) running water.

fields.title: Apply pressure
fields.instruction: Apply firm, steady pressure to the wound with a clean cloth.

fields.title: Keep pressure on
fields.instruction: Keep applying pressure and call for emergency help.

fields.title: Sit them down
fields.instruction: Help the person sit down in a comfortable, supported position.

fields.title: Call emergency services
fields.instruction: Call local emergency services right away — chest pain can be serious.

fields.title: Check responsiveness
fields.instruction: Check if the person responds to voice or touch.

fields.title: Call emergency services immediately
fields.instruction: Call local emergency services immediately and stay on the line.

fields.title: Encourage coughing
fields.instruction: Encourage the person to keep coughing if they can.

fields.title: Get trained help
fields.instruction: Call for emergency help or someone trained in first aid immediately.
